description: Elections Commission - Notice Under Section 7(4) (b) of the Parliamentary Elections Act. No. 1 of 1981. " The list of Political Parties and Party Secretaries".
reasoning: This gazette content is a notice under the Parliamentary Elections Act regarding the list of political parties entitled to be treated as recognized parties for an upcoming parliamentary election. It specifically addresses electoral processes, including which parties can submit nominations and which cannot due to disputes, making it clearly fall under the Elections classification (Type 7).
